1879050007.name: Rock-rubbing
1879050007.desc: A rubbing taken of the rune-covered rock on top of Amon-Sûl.

1879051671.name: Coin-pouch
1879051671.desc: A small pouch of coins grudgingly counted out by Lobelia Sackville-Baggins.

1879052183.name: The Book of Beasts, Page 26
1879052183.desc: A missing page from this legendary tome.

1879054871.name: Undeciphered Moon-letter
1879054871.desc: Moon letters were used to conceal some of the most important secrets of Middle-earth. These deserve careful and reverent study.\n\nThis item is used by Master Scholars.

1879054999.name: Aged Scrap of Text
1879054999.desc: An undeciphered scrap of text. Its purpose is not immediately clear.\n\nThis item can be used by Apprentice Scholars.

1879059863.name: The Joy of Battle, Page 24
1879059863.desc: A missing page from this legendary tome.

1879061399.name: Drop of Fine Clover Honey
1879061399.desc: Light, sweet, and extremely delicious.\n\nThis ingredient is sold by suppliers and profession vendors.

1879062423.name: Relic-fragment
1879062423.desc: This fragment of pottery was once a piece of great beauty, but now the beauty lies in pieces, buried beneath the snow of the Misty Mountains.

1879064855.name: Blackened Spider Spinneret
1879064855.desc: A trophy gathered from a spider corpse.

1879065111.name: Very Sharp Hillbeast Horn

1879065239.desc: A trophy gathered from a bear corpse.

1879065367.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a toad.

1879065495.name: Dusky Hendroval Wing
1879065495.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a hendroval.

1879065623.name: Hardened Neekerbreeker Leg
1879065623.desc: A trophy gathered from a neekerbreeker corpse.

1879065751.name: Albino Lynx Skin
1879065751.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a lynx.

1879065879.name: Razor Sharp Midge Stinger
1879065879.desc: A trophy gathered from dead midges.

1879066007.name: Razor Sharp Shrew Tooth
1879066007.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a shrew.

1879066135.name: Dry Huorn Twig
1879066135.desc: A trophy gathered from a dead Huorn.

1879066263.name: Heavy Sicklefly Carapace
1879066263.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a sicklefly.

1879066391.name: Smooth Worm Tongue
1879066391.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a worm.

1879069975.name: Book of Nature
1879069975.desc: Lore Skills cost less to cast.

1879070103.name: Greater Light-oil
1879070103.desc: This greater oil can be applied to your arrows or javelins, causing them to deal light damage.

1879070487.name: Dwarf-Steel Prospector's Tools
1879070487.desc: A set of prospecting tools used to extract and smelt metal ore.

1879072407.name: Hoarhallow Ale
1879072407.desc: A tasty draught made by the Hobbits of Hoarhallow.

1879076631.name: Pouch of Hornblower Pipe-weed
1879076631.desc: Named in honour of the first hobbit to grow pipe-weed in the Shire, Tobold Hornblower.

1879085335.name: Hobbit-seeking Charm
1879085335.desc: This charm can locate and track nearby hobbits.

1879087127.name: Stone Marker
1879087127.desc: An old stone marker. It bears some faint engravings that will require some time to decipher.

1879087255.name: Gauradan-basket
1879087255.desc: This object is a tribal artifact of the Gauredain. It is some sort of crude basket, but the meaning of the inscriptions and devices upon it remain a mystery.

1879088023.name: Scroll of Lesser Scholar Lore
1879088023.desc: Consumable scroll. Increases critical chance for the Scholar profession.

1879089815.name: Satchel of Relics
1879089815.desc: This satchel of relics was abandoned by tomb-robbers in their haste to escape the Duskencleft.

1879090071.name: Large Salamander Tail
1879090071.desc: A trophy gathered from the corpse of a salamander.

1879090839.name: Ancient-iron Bear Trap
1879090839.desc: An old hunter trap that can be turned back into ingots by a weaponsmith.

1879090967.name: Bow Chant: Major Breach-finder
1879090967.desc: Performing this bow chant empowers your bow with new strength: Your arrows bypass some of your target's armouring.

1879092247.name: Expert Standard of Hope
1879092247.desc: Increases the potency of the Captain's melee attacks.

1879094167.name: Major Maid-at-arms Herald Armaments
1879094167.desc: When equipped, your Call to Arms skills recruit a Maid-at-arms Herald.

1879098007.name: Racial Skill: Howl of Unnerving
1879098007.desc: An item granting the racial skill Howl of Unnerving, useable only by Wargs.

1879101847.name: 'Tom Bombadil' Theme
1879101847.desc: A selection of three Hobbit music pieces.

1879101975.name: Elm Tree
1879101975.desc: A single elm with green leaves.

1879102743.name: Guile Signal
1879102743.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Guile fellowship skills.

1879104279.name: Wet Fur
1879104279.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

Trophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

This item can be collected into task carry-alls.

<rgb=#FF0000>This item may be turned in for tasks in Bree-land.</rgb>

1879104407.name: Shimmering Essence
1879104407.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

Trophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

This item can be collected into task carry-alls.

<rgb=#FF0000>This item may be turned in for tasks in the Lone-lands and in Evendim.</rgb>

1879104535.name: Crooked Bark
1879104535.desc: A trophy gathered from a corpse.\n\nTrophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

1879104663.name: Grey Intestine
1879104663.desc: A trophy gathered from a corpse.\n\nTrophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

1879105303.name: Gross Goo
1879105303.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

1879105431.name: Impeccable Feeler
1879105431.desc: A trophy gathered from a corpse.\n\nTrophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

1879111063.name: Curing Barrel
1879111063.desc: A barrel used by the sled-builders to cure rawhide.

1879111575.name: Broken Long Bow
1879111575.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

Trophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

This item can be collected into task carry-alls.

<rgb=#FF0000>This item may be turned in for tasks in Eregion.</rgb>

1879112727.name: Map of Eregion
1879112727.desc: An old map of Eregion written on vellum.

1879118615.name: Spider-cleaver
1879118615.desc: When applied to a legendary item, this title provides additional weapon damage against Spiders and Insects.

1879125911.name: Large Master Symbol
1879125911.desc:
A large symbol created with the guild's master recipe.
<rgb=#00FF00>
Faction: Jeweller's Guild (3000 points)</rgb>

You must be in the Jeweller's Guild to use this item.

Use this item to immediately gain reputation in this faction.

1879127703.name: Gleaming Striker
1879127703.desc: When applied to a legendary item, this title provides additional light damage to light based skills.

1879132439.name: Blackened Bronze Band
1879132439.desc: This item is obsolete.\n\nAn old, hammered band made from blackened bronze.  This can be turned back into ingots by a metalsmith.

1879134743.name: Blue Lamp-fragment
1879134743.desc: A piece of blue glass from an ancient dwarf-lamp.

1879138199.name: Sealed Burglar's Tools of the Second Age

1879145111.name: Plaque
1879145111.desc: An ancient plaque with a symbol carved upon it.'

1879147799.name: Morhûn's Gemstone
1879147799.desc: A glowing gemstone from Morhûn's belt. This will be of some value to the taxidermists of Moria.

1879149335.name: Summon Very Small Mob
1879149335.desc: Summons a group of mobs appropriate for 3 to 4 players.

1879149975.name: Bundle of Arrows
1879149975.desc: This bundle of arrows are waiting to be delivered where they are needed.

1879150231.name: Bowl of Beef Stock
1879150231.desc: A beef-flavoured base for many creamy soups.

1879152023.name: Pristine Elf-stone of Strength
1879152023.desc: A small shiny Elf-stone. This can be exchanged in Caras Galadhon or Echad Andestel.

1879152663.name: Vintner's Tub
1879152663.desc: A tub used to crush grapes used in the making of wine.

1879153559.name: Blue Enamel
1879153559.desc: An enamel that can be quickly applied to a Rune-stone. Attunement will be shifted 3 steps further when applied.

1879154455.name: Weapon-rack
1879154455.desc: This rack holds many weapons for the Orcs in the Mirk-eaves.

1879157015.name: True Golden Wood Spear Scroll Case
1879157015.desc: On opening, the scroll case will reveal the True Golden Wood Spear recipe.\n\nYou must be friendly with the Galadhrim and Artisan of the Woodworker's Guild to use this item.

1879162775.name: Orc-crafted Weapon
1879162775.desc: Collected from the remains of a Dourhand Dwarf, this weapon appears to be crafted by Orcs, bearing cruder and more brutal edges than that of dwarf-make.

1879165591.name: Sealed Crafted Guardian's Belt of the Third Age

1879172887.name: Control Point Banner
1879172887.desc: Banner that indicates which side owns the control point.

1879173143.name: Request - Fishing Poles
1879173143.desc: Fishing poles will help the Eglain to survive as they can use them to fish among the few ponds found throughout the Lone-lands.

1879173655.name: Pot of Sweet Honey and Oats
1879173655.desc: When a Bear-friend consumes this, his coat glows with a subtle shine.

1879177879.name: The Artisan Blade, Page 4
1879177879.desc: A missing page from this legendary tome.

1879180183.name: Gold Smoker's Outfit
1879180183.desc: This item allows you to earn a trait to alter the appearance of your hobbit-lad Soldier's clothing to a gold smoker's outfit.

1879181975.name: Fake Dorwinion White
1879181975.desc: This is actually a tankard of Dorwinion Red, cleverly disguised as Dorwinion White.

1879182231.name: Small Bucket
1879182231.desc: This small bucket appears to be of hobbit-make, though of a more rustic style.

1879185815.name: Grant Elf-dance Emote
1879185815.desc: Using this item will grant you the first dance for the Elf race  (/dance_elf).

1879186071.name: Tome of Fate 5
1879186071.desc: Grants a permanent bonus to Fate.

1879186199.name: Tome of 1000 reclaimed Virtue XP VI
1879186199.desc: Select an earning virtue before use.\n\nPermanently increases Virtue experience points.

1879186455.name: Tome of 1000 reclaimed Virtue XP III
1879186455.desc: Select an earning virtue before use.\n\nPermanently increases Virtue experience points.

1879187351.name: Grant Jump Emote
1879187351.desc: Using this item will grant you the jump emote (/jump).

1879189399.name: Sturdy Artisan Jeweller's Tools
1879189399.desc: Finely-detailed crafting tools, moulds, clamps, and other tools of the jeweller's trade.

1879189783.name: Fine Lute Strings of Subtlety
1879189783.desc: Extremely fine lute strings that can lower your threat.

1879190295.name: Orange Dye
1879190295.desc: A phial of orange dye for clothing or armour.

1879190551.name: Blue Bottle
1879190551.desc: This blue bottle contains a mystery fluid.

1879191447.name: Supreme Reinforced Squire Herald Armaments
1879191447.desc: When equipped, your Call to Arms skills recruit a Squire Herald.

1879198871.name: Ranger Green Dye
1879198871.desc: A phial of Ranger green dye for clothing or armour.

1879199639.name: Savant's Honed Chisel of Lightning
1879199639.desc: Rune-keepers can attune themselves to specially crafted chisels, enhancing their powers.

1879201943.name: Upgrade Task Limit (+1)
1879201943.desc: Using this object will increase the number of tasks that you can complete in a day by one.

1879202455.name: Windmill
1879202455.desc: A large windmill earned during the Anniversary Event.

1879202839.name: Major Class Legacy:\nSure Strike Damage
1879202839.desc: Replaces any major legacy on your Captain's Emblem with a Tier 2 Sure Strike Damage Legacy.

1879203351.name: Minor Weapon Legacy:\nStill as Death Cooldown
1879203351.desc: Replaces any legacy on your weapon with a Tier 2 Still as Death Cooldown Legacy.

1879203479.name: Major Weapon Legacy:\nFury of Storm Damage
1879203479.desc: Replaces any major legacy on your weapon with a Tier 2 Fury of Storm Damage Legacy.

1879204375.name: Esteldín Whistle (30 days)
1879204375.desc: This whistle summons an Esteldín Steed that will remain at your beck and call for the next month.  This mighty steed is awarded to those of Kindred standing with the Rangers of Esteldín.  The Rangers of Esteldín can be found within Esteldín in the North Downs.

1879208727.name: Festival Skill: Essence of Toad
1879208727.desc: Using this item will teach you the Summer festival skill, Essence of Toad.

1879209751.name: Crude Fortification
1879209751.desc: A crude fortification designed to prevent riders from overrunning defending infantry.

1879212823.name: Westfold Potion of Focus
1879212823.desc: Imbibing this concoction sharpens the senses, providing 6 Focus and increasing the potency of your Devastating Critical Hits.

1879213079.name: Blackarrow Skill: In Your Face
1879213079.desc: Using this item will teach you the rank 3 Blackarrow skill, In Your Face.

1879213719.name: Enhanced Skill: Field Promotion
1879213719.desc: This item will reward your character with the Warleader trait, Enhanced Skill: Field Promotion.

1879213847.name: Resistance Boost 6
1879213847.desc: This item will reward your character with the Corruption, Tactical Resistance Boost (Rank 2).

1879214871.name: Westfold Bane of the Shield Carving
1879214871.desc: Greatly lowers the power cost on Shield Gambits.

1879219479.name: Worn Symbol of Celebrimbor
1879219479.desc: This small, hand-wrought ornament appears to have broken off from an ancient weapon.\n\nThis second age relic can be used by crafters who reforge level 75 second age weapons and class items.

1879220375.name: Snap-jaw Trap
1879220375.desc: A snap-jaw trap, capable of trapping and damaging up to three targets. The traps remain for 60 seconds after being placed. <rgb=#FF0000>Not useable in combat.</rgb>\n\nMost effective against targets level 75 or lower.

1879224343.name: Mark
1879224343.desc: Marks representing your successes. These can be traded at Skirmish camps.

1879229335.name: Scattered Arrows
1879229335.desc: A random scattering of fired arrows.

1879229847.name: Engraved Red Arrow
1879229847.desc: This engraved red arrow was used by Gondor to summon its allies in times of desperate need.\n\nThe Woodworker's Guild leader will accept this in exchange for a Sealed Westfold Device of Agility.

1879232279.name: Enduring Vitality III
1879232279.desc: When applied to a legendary item, this title increases tactical mitigation and adds a vitality rating.

1879233687.name: Dead-end
1879233687.desc: The rails do not go any further from this point.

1879234583.name: Goat Masked Pestilent Appearance
1879234583.desc: This item will reward your character with the Appearance trait, Goat Masked Pestilent Appearance.

1879239063.name: Skill: Favour of the Mearas
1879239063.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill Favour of the Mearas.

1879245975.name: Sharp Scale
1879245975.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

Trophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

This item can be collected into task carry-alls.

1879247639.name: Tome of Vitality 8
1879247639.desc: Grants a permanent bonus to Vitality.

1879247767.name: Orc-filth
1879247767.desc: A pile of filth, the smell of which you cannot identify, but have no wish to think further on the mystery.

1879249559.name: Tome of Mount Armour I
1879249559.desc: Grants a permanent +50 bonus to Mount Armour.

1879251095.name: Elthengels Banner
1879251095.desc: A banner with the emblem of Elthengels.

1879251223.name: Oaken Bagpipes of the Wary Watcher

1879251351.name: Scroll of Eastemnet Yeoman's Lore
1879251351.desc: Consumable scroll. Increases critical chance for the Cook, Farmer, and Tailor professions.

1879251735.name: Superior Tools of the Eastemnet Explorer
1879251735.desc: A collection of indispensable tools for tailors, foresters, and prospectors.

1879253911.name: Elven Wing Saddle
1879253911.desc: This item will reward your character with the Mounted Combat appearance trait, Elven Wing Saddle.

1879256087.name: Expert Tailor Crafting
1879256087.desc: This item will allow you to finish Expert Tier Tailor crafting.

1879256215.name: Apprentice Weaponsmith Mastery
1879256215.desc: This item will allow you to finish Apprentice Tier Weaponsmith Mastery.

1879256343.name: Master Forester Mastery
1879256343.desc: This item will allow you to finish Master Tier Forester Mastery.

1879257239.name: Bundle of 4000 reclaimed Virtue XP
1879257239.desc: Select an earning virtue before use.\n\nPermanently increases Virtue experience points.

1879269399.name: Premium Relic Pack
1879269399.desc: Use this to be granted five relics from tier 8 to tier 10.\n\nThis item does not need to be deconstructed at a relic master.  Simply double click to use it.

1879269527.name: Enduring Tactics II
1879269527.desc: When applied to a legendary item, this title increases tactical mitigation and adds a critical rating.

1879272727.name: Strange Token
1879272727.desc: A token bearing distinctly Rohirric markings.

1879275799.name: Superior Beans on Toast
1879275799.desc: Delicious and filling, this meal is great any time of the day!\n\nOnly one trail food can be active at a time.

1879280151.name: Eorlingas Inlay
1879280151.desc: An inlay that can be quickly applied to a Rune-stone. The next induction cannot be interrupted.

1879283095.name: Empty Weapon Barrel
1879283095.desc: An empty barrel bearing marks of the blades it once held.

1879283863.name: Superior Tools of the Expert Tinker
1879283863.desc: A collection of indispensable tools for jewellers, prospectors, and cooks.

1879287703.name: Pitted Sword Sheath
1879287703.desc:
A trophy gathered from a corpse.

Trophies can be sold to vendors for coin.

This item can be collected into task carry-alls.

<rgb=#FF0000>This item may be turned in for tasks in West Rohan, Gondor, and Old Anórien .</rgb>

1879302679.name: Archer-armaments of the Footsoldier
1879302679.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill to call a footsoldier archer.

1879305623.name: Sticky Apple
1879305623.desc: A roasted apple smothered in honey and cinnamon. Increases hope by 3 for twenty minutes.\n\nOnly one carnival food can be active at a time.

1879312791.name: Short Shelf of Gondorian Mugs
1879312791.desc: A shelf of mugs from Gondor.

1879318423.name: Tome of Vitality 13
1879318423.desc: Grants a permanent bonus to Vitality.

1879320855.name: Treasure Cache
1879320855.desc: Ancient treasure that has been lost, forgotten, or perhaps was stolen.

1879324055.name: Tome of the Ginger Cat
1879324055.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill to summon a ginger cat.

1879326359.name: Large Imloth Melui White Rose Bush
1879326359.desc: Beautiful rose bushes from the gardens of Lossarnach.

1879326487.name: Tome of the Light Brown Goat
1879326487.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill to summon a light brown goat.

1879327511.name: Gondorian Oven
1879327511.desc: An oven for crafting at home.

1879328407.name: Books
1879328407.desc: Books and scrolls fill the Old Archives from floor to ceiling, but any secret to their cataloguing has long been lost.

1879329687.name: Dark Clay Dye
1879329687.desc: A phial of Dark Clay Dye for clothing or armour.

1879330327.name: Treasure
1879330327.desc: This coffer contains treasure the Orcs stole from folk on the road.

1879332631.name: Tome of the Skittish Black Horse
1879332631.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill to summon a skittish black horse.

1879338135.name: Sun-touched Morgul-troll
1879338135.desc: A Morgul-troll caught in the sun as the Dawnless Day ended.

1879338647.name: Banner of King Elessar
1879338647.desc: Banner displaying the symbol of King Elessar.

1879341335.name: Antlers of Winter's Light
1879341335.desc: This item will reward your character with the Mounted Combat appearance trait, Antlers of Winter's Light.

1879342231.name: Slain Ranger
1879342231.desc: A slain Ranger of Ithilien bearing no visible wounds.

1879342359.name: Set of Padded Gondorian Garments
1879342359.desc: A set of reinforced clothwork for the Host of the West. Includes shirts, trousers, tabards, and banners.\n\nDesired by the Host of the West's Master-armourer, Master-weaponist, and Master-provisioner.

1879356183.name: Chapter 5: A Meal in Cormallen
1879356183.desc: Your presence has been requested in Bâr Thorenion. Your hobbit friends might be up to something...

1879357591.name: Web-covered Page
1879357591.desc: In Shelob's wrath, her children flooded the passages beneath the tower, killing all they encountered. However, she relented before her children reached the cellars of Cirith Ungol - a mercy later repaid in sacrifices by Orcs seeking safe passage.

1879357719.name: Lost Lore: Dor Amarth
1879357719.desc: A record of the lost lore of Dor Amarth.

1879358999.name: Comforting Packages
1879358999.desc: These small packages contain words of comfort and a number of helpful supplies for Elves adventuring in Gorgoroth.

1879362583.name: Watcher - Cirith Ungol
1879362583.desc: A replica of a watching-stone. It is most certainly free of spirits. Probably.

1879363351.name: Scrap of Paper
1879363351.desc: It seems to be part of a larger tome. Some Dwarvish runes appear on this page.

1879363479.name: Weapons Rack
1879363479.desc: A weapons rack filled with various swords and spears.

1879366167.name: Treasure Cache
1879366167.desc: Ancient treasure, plundered and forgotten, from deep within Erebor.

1879370135.name: Ironfold Serrated Knife
1879370135.desc: The saw-like blade of a serrated knife leaves a wound that can weaken the toughest of opponents.\n\nMost effective against targets level 120 or lower.

1879379223.name: Lost Lore: Ironfold
1879379223.desc: A record of the lost lore of the Ironfold.

1879381655.name: Basic Costume Grab-bag
1879381655.desc: Lobelia Grubb and her friends took some old thing out of the bin and stuffed it into this bag, to be handed out. You probably won't know what of until you've put it on.

1879381783.name: Steaming Stein
1879381783.desc: A stein filled with what you assume to be freshly-brewed coffee. You don't think anyone would mind if you took a small sip.

1879384215.name: Sealed Greater Winterstith Rune of Enchantment
1879384215.desc: A Relic-master can deconstruct this item, unsealing the relic locked within.\nSlottable in weapons only

1879385751.name: Ironfold Jeweller Crafting
1879385751.desc: This item will allow you to finish Ironfold Tier Jeweller crafting.

1879386519.name: Vales - Woodmen Token
1879386519.desc: A token given to you for aiding the Woodmen in the Vales of Anduin.

1879386775.name: Anduin Moss
1879386775.desc: Moss growing from the moisture of the river.

1879391383.name: Victory-armaments of the Elvish Maid-at-arms
1879391383.desc: Using this item will teach you the skill to call an Elvish Maid-at-arms of Victory.

1879391639.name: Metal Base
1879391639.desc: This is good place to plant a banner of Gondor.

1879393047.name: Recklessness - Imbued Second Age Javelin
1879393047.desc: Using this item will grant powerful Imbued Javelin for Wardens.

1879393303.name: Recklessness - Imbued Third Age Spear
1879393303.desc: Using this item will grant a powerful Imbued Spear for Wardens.

1879396631.name: Minas Ithil Bagpipes of the Battle-singer

1879397271.name: Scroll of the Minas Ithil Guard
1879397271.desc:
Increases your mitigations.

Only one Guard scroll may be active at a time.

Not effective if used after level 130.

1879397527.name: The Protector of Song - Imbued First Age Mace
1879397527.desc: Using this item will grant a powerful Imbued Mace for Minstrels.

1879403799.name: Northern Gúlmark
1879403799.desc: A token used for tolls and trade in the Wells of Langflood.

1879404055.name: Eat in Silence
1879404055.desc: The rations were old and tasteless when the dwarves brought them to Skarháld, and they have not improved in the subsequent days. But they will serve a purpose: blunting your hunger and giving you a break from conversation.

1879404439.name: Sealed Darkened Remmorchant Setting of Brutality
1879404439.desc: A Relic-master can deconstruct this item, unsealing the relic locked within.

1879406103.name: Socketed Pedestal
1879406103.desc: Something is meant to fit into this socket….

1879408151.name: Tome of the Blue Firefly
1879408151.desc: Using this item will teach you to summon a humble blue firefly.

1879409047.name: Throne of Gondor - Replica
1879409047.desc: To be clear, this is merely a replica.

1879412631.name: Metal Base
1879412631.desc: This is good place to plant a banner of the Longbeards.

1879413527.name: Roast Dinner Plate
1879413527.desc: A dinner plate fit for any hobbit, or at least someone with the appetite of a hobbit!

1879414167.name: Beacon of Gondor Frame
1879414167.desc: This item, when used, will grant you a new portrait frame.

1879415191.name: Goblin Coin-purse
1879415191.desc: This purse contains some good coinage mixed with the bad, but all of it will require a good scrubbing to remove years of goblin-filth.

1879415319.name: A Good Spot To Burn Bark
1879415319.desc: This seems like an ideal spot to burn the rotten huorn bark.
